entities.summary: San Marino was represented at the Eurovision Song Contest 2017, held in Kyiv, Ukraine. The Sammarinese national broadcaster San Marino RTV (SMRTV) internally selected Sammarinese singer Valentina Monetta and American singer Jimmie Wilson with "Spirit of the Night" to represent the nation in the contest. Monetta had previously represented San Marino as a solo artist on three previous occasions. The 2017 entry in the Eurovision Song Contest was promoted through the creation of a music video and promotional performances in Tel Aviv, Amsterdam and Madrid.
